t.zh: 认得出一帧从哪开始，也会把位攒成数，探针就能读出第一样东西：这一帧是哪条消息。每一帧开头是 11 位的<wiki-ref to="identifier"></wiki-ref>，说的是这条消息是什么、有多要紧。
t.en: Knowing where a frame starts and how to gather bits into a number, the probe can read the first thing: which message this frame is. Every frame begins with an 11-bit <wiki-ref to="identifier"></wiki-ref>, which says what the message is and how urgent.

t.zh: 一个帧起始只亮一拍，可之后的 11 拍都要知道"我在一帧里面"。
t.en: A start of frame lights for one tick, yet the 11 ticks after it all need to know “I am inside a frame”.

after.zh: 两块计数器各数各的：一块数总线安静了多久，一块数进帧以后过了几拍。
after.en: The two counters count on their own: one how long the bus was quiet, one how many ticks since the frame began.

brief.zh: 帧起始后面的 11 位是这一帧的标识符。在它最后一位到达的那一拍交出标识符，其余每一拍交出「—」。
brief.en: The 11 bits after the start of frame are the frame’s identifier. Give it out on the tick its last bit arrives, and 「—」 on every other tick.

hint.zh: 帧起始那一拍，在寄存卡里记下"进帧了"，之后一直记着。
hint.en: On the start of frame, keep “in a frame” in a register, and keep it there.

hint.zh: 进帧以后的拍数，用一块<part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>数。
hint.en: Count the ticks since then with a <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>.
